convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iRSI indicator with standard parameters. Simple entry/exit rules based on RSI levels. Fixed lot position sizing. No external .mqh libraries. No custom indicators. No grid, martingale, or hedging logic.

derived_values.name: RSI qualification filter - RSI must be beyond threshold levels to qualify trade direction

other_exits: RSI reaching opposite zone qualifies reversal and closes existing position before opening opposite

custom_logic_notes: The 'qualified' aspect of RSI means the EA waits for RSI to enter an extreme zone (below 30 for long qualification, above 70 for short qualification) and then triggers on the reversal crossover back out of that zone. This is a two-stage filter: RSI must first penetrate the threshold, then cross back, confirming the reversal. Digit adjustment is applied to SL/TP values (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers).
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. RSI can be computed via talib or pandas_ta. The 'qualification' logic requires tracking whether RSI has entered the extreme zone before triggering on the reversal cross. Implement a state flag (rsi_qualified_long, rsi_qualified_short) that sets when RSI enters the zone and resets after a trade is taken or RSI reverses without crossing. SL/TP pip values need broker digit detection for the 10x adjustment. New bar detection via bar timestamp comparison. Position check before entry via open position count query.
